newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Leasing Solutions rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Leasing Solutions rating raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said Friday it raised its intermediate-term rating on Leasing Solutions Inc to outperform from market performer. Long-term rating remains outperform.

-- Estimate for 1997 earnings was raised to $1.48 a share, up $0.02, while 1998 estimate was raised to $1.75, up $0.05, to reflect a more rapid increase in volume from the company's Cisco Systems Inc program than expected, EVEREN said.

-- "The company plans to announce a major new vendor relationship within 3-4 weeks which could replace up to 50 percent of the lost Dell volume," EVEREN said in a research note. Dell Computer Corp, which had worked with Leasing Solutions, earlier this month decided to form an affiliate leasing company with a Canadian firm.
-- Leasing Solutions shares were up 3/8 at 11-7/8 Friday.
